read_contract: Read the additive raw parts together, with each part's source-packet/check-output/exposure/timing. completion_limit: Source recovery DONE does not approve the target workflow, resolve its source contradictions, prove runtime behavior, or claim unrelated later design/execution internals were executed or exhaustively traced.
